checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: Encode uses FK of each demonstrated seven-joint command. Decode reconstructs the same world TCP translation and rotation before shared damped least-squares IK. The check takes the maximum of FK position error in metres, rotation angle in radians and gripper scalar error. Rotation 6D receives only the declared Gram-Schmidt projection; IK returns its best limit-respecting solution and reports convergence, residuals and limit contacts without silent substitution.

contract.cut_relation: One policy and one empty-argument invocation contract cover every action [0,stop) of every complete original demonstration. There are no cuts, segment selectors, stage labels, policy switches or caller-selected objects.
contract.output_semantics: Each prediction slot is [dx,dy,dz,r1x,r1y,r1z,r2x,r2y,r2z,g]. Position is in world metres relative to a fresh-observation continuous relational anchor: a normalized blend of current container, bowl and marked-return origins. The blend is determined only from current container elevation/uprightness and observed particle geometry. The six rotation values are the first two columns of the desired TCP rotation in the current observed container frame and are projected by Gram-Schmidt; g preserves the demonstrated native gripper scalar. Slots represent t-1 through t+14 and execution uses slots 1 through 8. For every executed slot, the fresh current observation reconstructs a world TCP pose; panda_kinematics.solve_ik converts it from freshly measured qpos to seven absolute Panda joint targets. The relational anchor is a coordinate conversion, not a scripted action or stage controller.
contract.parameter_semantics: There are no caller parameters. The single binding means: execute the complete granular_pour_return task from causal observed state. Object, bowl and return poses are resolved from each observation in world metres with wxyz pose quaternions; no caller selects an object, stage or controller.
